title.narrative: Plant And Animal Disease, Pest Control, And Animal Care

description.narrative: The Purpose Of This Agreement Is To Mitigate The Pest Risk, Offshore, For New Pests Entering And Becoming Established In The Greater Caribbean Region, Which Includes The United States. The Greater Caribbean Safeguarding Initiative, A National Program See Expected Outcomes And Goals Are: The Utilization Of The Caribbean Plant Health Directors And Greater Caribbean Safeguarding Initiative Networks To Strengthen Monitoring Frameworks And Reporting Mechanisms That Result In An Effective Region-wide System To Support Advanced And Timely Notifications Of Significant Quarantine Pests Entering The Greater Caribbean Region; The Development And Deployment Of Effective Strategies, Aligned With International Standards And Risk Analysis, In Collaboration With Regional Partners To Identify And Address High-risk Pathways With The Potential To Move Pest Of Quarantine Significance Into And Within The Greater Caribbean Region; Utilizing Existing Frameworks, The Development Of A Comprehensive, And Scalable, Regional Emergency Response And Recovery Plan To Support The Joint Response Capability Of Regional National Plant Protection Organizations, The Caribbean Plant Health Directors, The Greater Caribbean Safeguarding Initiative, And Other Regional Partners; The Maximization Of Greater Caribbean Safeguarding Initiative And Caribbean Plant Health Directors Collaborators To Achieve An Expanded And Effective Network That Results In The Sharing And Dissemination Of Timely Information, Leveraging Collaboration, Coordination, And Outreach Opportunities Among United States Entities And External Regional Partners-in Alignment With Greater Caribbean Safeguarding Initiative Operational Goals; And The Identification, Categorization, And Increase In The Available Regional Resources To Support The Greater Caribbean Safeguarding Initiative Safeguarding Activities In The Greater Caribbean Region.
